articles.title: I visited the elite United States Naval Academy in Annapolis. An 8-minute ceremony gave me goosebumps.
articles.summary: The United States Naval Academy, located in Annapolis, Maryland, is a pivotal institution dedicated to training future leaders for the U.S. Navy and Marine Corps. It focuses on developing essential leadership qualities, strategic acumen, and technical skills necessary for officers to command effectively and contribute to national security, preparing them for rigorous service roles.

articles.title: Karnataka bandh against Cauvery water release to Tamil Nadu loses momentum
articles.summary: Karnataka experienced a bandh, initiated by pro-Kannada activist Vatal Nagaraj, protesting the release of Cauvery river water to Tamil Nadu. The statewide shutdown evoked a mixed response, with intense protests and disruptions reported in Mandya, contrasting with Bengaluru's varied adherence. This event underscores the persistent inter-state water dispute between Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, posing a significant challenge for regional stability and resource management.

articles.title: Anand Mahindra can't stop praising two IITian-led 10-gram cooler that broke Western monopoly: 'Deep tech doesn't need deep....'
articles.summary: India has achieved a significant breakthrough with a completely homegrown 10-gram cooling technology. This innovation has successfully broken the long-standing Western dominance and monopoly previously held by the US, France, and Israel in this critical sector. This highlights India's growing prowess and self-reliance in advanced scientific and technological research and development.

articles.title: Transfer rumour roundup: Man Utd brace for Bruno Fernandes bids; Spurs weigh move for Villarreal hotshot Georges Mikautadze
articles.summary: Thursday's football transfer rumours reveal potential moves for players like Eduardo Camavinga, Folarin Balogun, and Martin Zubimendi. Manchester United is bracing for significant interest in Bruno Fernandes before the transfer deadline, with top European clubs like Juventus and AC Milan reportedly keen. This highlights the fluid and high-stakes player market within international football.

articles.title: REBUILDING THE UNITED STATES NAVY AND AMERICA'S SHIPBUILDING INDUSTRIAL BASE
articles.summary: This Presidential Memorandum, dated August 13, 2026, outlines executive directives to critical officials including the Secretary of War, Director of OMB, and Assistant to the President for National Security. Such presidential actions are crucial for SSB aspirants to understand, highlighting high-level governmental coordination and strategic policy formulation concerning national defence and security matters.
